plugins.name: codelore
plugins.description: Project docs as an auto-loaded context layer for AI sessions. Four skills: write, bulk-migrate, route into context, and critically review.

plugins.name: qa-vault-skills
plugins.description: Skills that make an AI agent a QA practitioner for the QA Vault platform: author, maintain, search, and organize manual UI test scenarios — including the search abstracts that power two-vector semantic search — and turn them into automated Playwright e2e tests: generate, heal, run, and report, closed-loop through the QA Vault MCP.

plugins.name: quality-loop
plugins.description: A three-layer quality loop for AI-generated code: a contract-driven testing discipline for unit and integration suites (verified by mutation testing and provoked real-infrastructure failures), a deterministic pre-PR Semgrep gate with project-owned rules, and critical triage of Greptile AI reviews — closed by a human-approved ratchet that turns recurring findings into rules. Bring your own Semgrep install and Greptile account.
